handles.title: Accounts
handles.description: Bluesky accounts to scrape, one per line. Accepts handles ("nytimes.com", "@user.bsky.social"), profile URLs ("https://bsky.app/profile/bsky.app") or DIDs.

includeProfile.title: Include profile row
includeProfile.description: Emit one profile row per account: display name, bio, follower/following/post counts, join date, avatar.

includePosts.title: Include posts
includePosts.description: Emit the account's recent posts with text, timestamps, like/repost/reply/quote counts, links and hashtags.

maxPostsPerHandle.title: Posts per account
maxPostsPerHandle.description: How many recent posts to fetch for each account (newest first).

includeReposts.title: Include reposts
includeReposts.description: Also emit posts the account reposted (marked with repostedByHandle). Off = original posts only.

includeReplies.title: Include replies
includeReplies.description: Also emit the account's replies to other posts. Off = top-level posts only.

includeFollowers.title: Include followers
includeFollowers.description: Emit one profile row per follower of each account, with full follower/post counts and bio.

includeFollows.title: Include following
includeFollows.description: Emit one profile row per account each handle follows, with full counts and bio.

maxFollowersPerHandle.title: Followers / following per account
maxFollowersPerHandle.description: Cap on follower and following rows fetched per account.

searchQueries.title: People search
searchQueries.description: Find accounts by keyword, one search per line ("data journalist", "indie hacker"). Each match becomes a full profile row - a lead list of accounts in a niche.

maxAccountsPerQuery.title: Accounts per search
maxAccountsPerQuery.description: How many matching accounts to return for each people search.

postUrls.title: Post URLs
postUrls.description: Individual posts to look up, one URL per line ("https://bsky.app/profile/bsky.app/post/3l6oveex3ii2l"). Returns the post with its engagement counts.

includeLikers.title: Include post likers
includeLikers.description: For each post URL, also emit one profile row per account that liked it - see exactly who engages with a post.

maxLikersPerPost.title: Likers per post
maxLikersPerPost.description: Cap on liker rows fetched per post URL.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows in total.
